---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Teams |> 
  group_by(yearID) |> 
  summarize(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G)
  )
```

```{r}
Teams |> 
  group_by(yearID) |> 
  summarize(total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = total_home_runs)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Total Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```

```{r}
Teams |> 
  filter(yearID %in% c(1981, 1994, 2019, 2020)) |> 
  group_by(yearID) |> 
  summarize(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G),
    hr_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games
  )
```

```{r}
hr_by_season <- Teams |> 
  group_by(yearID) |> 
  summarize(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G),
    hr_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games
  ) |> 
  mutate(season_type = if_else(
    yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
    "Shortened",
    "Regular"
  ))
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hr_by_season |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr_per_game)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = season_type)) +
  labs(
    title = "Home Runs per Game by Season",
    subtitle = "Shortened seasons align with the overall historical trend",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs per Team-Game",
    color = "Season Type",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```
